<!-- Python code makes on target editing bar plot, and off target sites plot -->
```{python}
#| include: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams.update({
    "text.usetex": False,
    "font.family": "serif",
    "mathtext.fontset": "cm",  # Computer Modern mathtext
})

def parse_offtarget_file(file_path, filter_on_target=False):
    """Parse the off-target file and return x and y values."""
    x_values, y_values = [], []
    with open(file_path) as data:
        header = data.readline()  # Skip header
        for line in data:
            stripped_line = line.rstrip().split("\t")
            # Ensure the row has enough columns
            if len(stripped_line) < 16:
                continue
            try:
                chrom, start, end = stripped_line[0], stripped_line[1], stripped_line[2]
                indel_fraction = float(stripped_line[6])
                is_target = int(stripped_line[15])  # Check the is_target column
                if filter_on_target and is_target != 1:
                    continue
                if not filter_on_target and is_target == 1:
                    continue
                if indel_fraction == 0:
                    continue
                loci = f"{chrom}:{start}-{end}"
                x_values.append(loci)
                y_values.append(indel_fraction * 100)  # Convert to percentage
            except (ValueError, IndexError):
                # Skip rows with invalid data
                continue
    return x_values, y_values

def plot_bar_chart(x_values, y_values, xlabel, ylabel, title, output_file, type, highlight_line=None):
    """Create and save a bar chart."""
    if type == 'on target':
        plt.figure(figsize=(9, 9.5))
    else:
        plt.figure(figsize=(9, 5))
    plt.bar(x_values, y_values, color='skyblue')
    if highlight_line:
        plt.axhline(y=highlight_line['value'], color=highlight_line['color'], linestyle='-', linewidth=2)
        plt.text(x=x_values[-1], y=highlight_line['value'], s=highlight_line['label'], 
                 color=highlight_line['color'], fontsize=12, va='bottom', ha='left')
    plt.xlabel(rf"{xlabel}", fontsize=20)
    plt.ylabel(rf"{ylabel}", fontsize=20)
    plt.xticks([])  # Remove x-axis ticks and labels
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(output_file, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.close()

# On-targets plot (filtered from offtargets file)
x_values, y_values = parse_offtarget_file(r.params['offtargets'], filter_on_target=True)
sorted_data = sorted(zip(y_values, x_values), reverse=True)
y_values, x_values = zip(*sorted_data)
plot_bar_chart(
    x_values, y_values, 
    xlabel='On-target loci', 
    ylabel='Indel frequency (%)', 
    title='On-target editing', 
    type='on target',
    output_file='indel_freq.png'
)

# Off-targets plot
x_values, y_values = parse_offtarget_file(r.params['offtargets'], filter_on_target=False)
sorted_data = sorted(zip(y_values, x_values), reverse=True)
y_values, x_values = zip(*sorted_data)
plot_bar_chart(
    x_values, y_values, 
    xlabel='Predicted off-target sites', 
    ylabel='Indel frequency (%)', 
    title='Off-target sites', 
    output_file='off_targets.png', 
    type='off target',
    highlight_line={'value': 1.0, 'color': 'red', 'label': '1.0%'}
)
```
